verdict.rationale: Missive's docs and a runtime probe confirm a live MCP server letting AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT) summarize inboxes, draft replies, and triage conversations against CRM data using real conversation/contact/calendar scopes — this is genuine AI-generated insight from in-product data. However, this capability is delivered via connecting an external AI client rather than a native in-app insights/suggestions surface, and there's no independent hands-on report validating insight quality. Missing for 10: native in-Missive AI insight/suggestion UI (not requiring external client setup), independent user validation of suggestion usefulness.
